follow-up time: Prospectively followed for the duration of their pregnancy and delivery
cohort: 120 pregnant women with preeclampsia scheduled for caesarean delivery at a regional hospital in Durban, South Africa
finding: Early onset preeclampsia is associated with more severe maternal complications and poorer fetal outcomes compared to late onset preeclampsia, with HIV status also influencing maternal and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with early onset preeclampsia had a higher proportion of scheduled cesarean deliveries and experienced more maternal complications and poorer fetal outcomes compared to those with late onset preeclampsia.
